decisions.statement: A script arrives as lines closed by a run sentinel of its own.
An answer is one JSON document closed by a done sentinel of its own.
An answer says whether the script ran and has either a value or an error.
A script that fails to compile answers as an error rather than ending the loop.
A script that throws answers as an error rather than ending the loop.
A table whose keys start at 1 and rise with no gap is written as a JSON array.
Every other table is written as a JSON object.
A number JSON cannot have is written as a tagged object.
A function is written as a tagged object rather than as a value.

definition: the loop a Lua subprocess runs, reading scripts in and writing answers back
